2026 Porsche 911 GT3 Touring | Porsche Approved Certified | One Owner | Clean CARFAX

EXTERIOR: White
INTERIOR: Leather Interior in Black with Fabric Seat Centers

This 2026 Porsche 911 GT3 Touring is offered as a Porsche Approved Certified Pre-Owned vehicle, presenting an extraordinarily rare specification built around the full Lightweight Package — one of the most focused, purpose-built GT3 Tourings available anywhere. Carfax confirms a true one-owner history with no accidents, no structural damage, no airbag deployment, and a guaranteed clean title.

Factory Options & Build Highlights:

Lightweight Package in Black including Roof in Exposed Carbon Fiber and 20"/21" 911 GT3 Forged Magnesium Lightweight Wheels
Porsche Ceramic Composite Brakes (PCCB) with Calipers in High Gloss Black
7-speed Porsche Doppelkupplung (PDK)
Front Axle Lift System
Exterior Mirror Upper Trims in Carbon Fiber
Wheels Painted in Satin Black
Adaptive Sport Seats Plus (18-way)
Rear Seats
Center Console Lid with Porsche Crest
Roof Lining in Race-Tex
HD-Matrix Design LED Headlights in Black
Exclusive Design Taillights
Storage Net in Passenger Footwell
Under Door Puddle Light Projectors

Vehicle Overview:

Finished in White over a Black leather interior with fabric seat centers, this GT3 Touring presents one of the most extraordinary specifications available, anchored by the full Lightweight Package. The Roof in Exposed Carbon Fiber and 20"/21" 911 GT3 Forged Magnesium Lightweight Wheels shed meaningful weight while putting this Touring's motorsport-derived engineering on full display, making it one of the lightest, most track-capable GT3 Tourings in existence.

Porsche Ceramic Composite Brakes with High Gloss Black calipers deliver uncompromising stopping power, while the 7-speed Porsche Doppelkupplung (PDK) transmission brings lightning-quick shifts to complement the GT3's naturally aspirated flat-six. A Front Axle Lift System adds genuine everyday usability, while genuine Rear Seats offer added versatility without sacrificing the car's track-focused intent. Carbon Fiber exterior mirror trims and Satin Black-painted wheels further the purposeful, motorsport-inspired aesthetic throughout.

Inside, Race-Tex roof lining, a Center Console Lid with Porsche Crest, and 18-way Adaptive Sport Seats Plus create a driver-focused cabin built for serious performance, while HD-Matrix Design LED Headlights in Black and Exclusive Design Taillights round out a specification that is as visually striking as it is track-capable.

Offered here as a Porsche Approved Certified Pre-Owned vehicle, this GT3 Touring carries the added confidence of Porsche's CPO multi-point inspection, making it an exceptionally rare opportunity to own one of the most comprehensively equipped GT3 Tourings available.

THE 911 GT3 TOURING. WHITE OVER BLACK LEATHER WITH FABRIC SEAT CENTERS. PORSCHE APPROVED CERTIFIED PRE-OWNED EXAMPLE EQUIPPED WITH THE FULL LIGHTWEIGHT PACKAGE, PCCB, AND FORGED MAGNESIUM WHEELS. THE ULTIMATE EXPRESSION OF GT3 TOURING.
